progress_summary: Diagnosed route:pane.create from the phase instrumentation PR #4361 added: phase:pane.create.managed_assets p50 34,001 ms (09-16) / 42,371 ms (09-17) against a measured 330-660 ms uncontended cost. Root cause was with_managed_asset_lock keying its exclusive file lock on the repository's main worktree root, so one lock covered every worktree and every pane launch, fresh-worktree SessionStart self-heal and startup hook self-heal serialized on it. Keyed the lock on the worktree and kept a short repository-scoped lock only around the two writes that cross worktrees (.git/info/exclude and the workspace-home .codex/hooks.json). Completed the route attribution: phase:pane.create.asset_lock_wait splits the managed_assets phase into queueing vs work, and RoutePhaseClock::mark_total records phase:pane.create.launch_thread so the route minus that value is the hand-back to the GUI event loop (~85% of a light-day route, owned by #4406). AC-6 regression test asserts a sibling worktree's held lock does not block materialization under an operation deadline: 20.55 s deadline expiry before, 0.99 s after.
